turns.thought: Off somewhere, and nobody said where. Good.
A friendly tune, all that talking.
Well. Not my finest moment. Settled now.
A rest, then. I'll take it.
What was that? Something heavy, I'd bet.
A ride. Where to is their business.
Somewhere level, I'd say. Nothing tipping.
Whatever they're doing, it's private. Fair.

turns.wink: Work. Take me along or leave me, either's fine.

turns.thought: Taken to work, then. What does work sound like?
Was that on purpose? Hard to tell.
That made me jump. Now I want to know why.
Here, then. Wherever here is.
Down the moment they got home. Tired, maybe.
A secret, I'd guess. Not mine to know.
Back to normal now. That was brisk.
A door, maybe. Or someone dropped a pan.
There they are. Friends have a lively tune.
Time to think, then. Whatever they're up to.

turns.wink: Damn it, it says. What isn't working?

turns.thought: Shaken for not working. I was working. Mostly.
Big, then little noises after. Cleaning up?
They want a minute to themselves. Reasonable.

turns.wink: Coffee. Tell me how it smells.

turns.thought: Invited along for coffee. Didn't see that coming.
I hope that helped them, whatever it was.
Startled. Then interested. Mostly interested.
Still now. Did they sit down too?
That tune sounds like a question.

turns.wink: Look? I couldn't if I tried.

turns.thought: Turned over so I won't look. Sweet of them.
Is this a short trip or a long one?
Nose down, more or less. Restful.
Somebody's having a very loud moment.
A low hum of talking. Easy to listen to.
Like a snow globe. Nothing fell out.
Parked for a while, I think.

turns.wink: Your brother. Is he a loud one?

turns.thought: A loud arrival. The brother, I'd guess.
Into a bag, maybe. Or just a hand.
Lots of them at once. A dinner, I'd guess.
Out of the way of something serious, maybe.
Set aside for a two hand job. Cooking?
Somebody's testing something. I passed, I think.
That one sounded close. Next door, maybe?
No word, just a lift. Busy, then.
Everyone talking at once. A busy cafe, then.
Something I shouldn't hear? I only get the tune.
Fireworks, or someone's bad day?
More awake than I was. Thanks, I suppose.

turns.wink: Outside. You'll have to tell me what it's like.

turns.thought: Outside, they said. I'll listen for it.
A good place for listening, I hope.
Muffled now. That's all right.
Was that a laugh? A very big laugh?
Where are we off to? I'll find out.
Is one of those voices theirs? I think so.
They shook me to check. That's one way.
Is this a stop or the end of the trip?
Nap time, apparently. Not my idea, but fine.
That bang was the cake, I bet. Or the oven.
Not a word I can make out. Fine by me.
I'll guess a kitchen and be wrong.
Next to their keys, I bet. Or a cup.
Something fell, maybe. I hope it wasn't them.
Not cross with me, I hope. Just busy.

turns.wink: Bored of the room or the day?

turns.thought: Bored enough to go somewhere. Good call.
They let go. Off to do something with both hands.
So that's the family. Plenty of overlap.
I'll pretend that was a dance.
Here and gone. What a strange visitor.
They need to focus, I think. Fair enough.
Mid thought, and away we go. It'll keep.
Somebody's on the phone, by the sound of it.

turns.wink: A shower. I'll stay dry over here.

turns.thought: Left somewhere dry. Kind of them.
Down for concentrating. I'll be very still.
Thunder, maybe. Or a truck. I can't tell which.
The talking has a warm sort of shape.
Not tossed. I'll take that as respect.
The hammering, I suppose. I hope the thumbs are fine.
Arguing? No, I think that's just how they talk.

turns.wink: The job! Good news. Well done.

turns.thought: A happy shake, I think. The good kind.
Somebody wants me along. Nice.
The ride's over, wherever it went.
Strangers on the bus, chatting low.
I'd join in if I knew the words.
I hope it's somewhere loud and friendly.
Tucked in face first for the night. Fine by me.
